title: Red Hat Security Advisory: freerdp security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in FreeRDP, a free implementation of the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). These include denial of service and remote code execution issues caused by heap buffer overflows, out-of-bounds reads, uninitialized heap memory disclosure, and buffer over-reads. The vulnerabilities affect the xfreerdp client and related components. Red Hat has issued an important security update for affected Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.4 versions to address these issues.
